description: This file implements a custom GStreamer source element 'GstSrc' for the Rialto media platform, including class definitions, property handling, message processing, and setup functions for media streaming with DRM and payloader support.

classes.name: GstSrc
classes.description: A custom GStreamer source element class for Rialto, managing media source setup, DRM, and payloader integration.

methods.name: initSrc
methods.description: Initializes the source element, registering 'rialtosrc' if not already registered.

methods.name: setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Configures and adds appsrc, decryptor, payloader, and queue elements to the source pipeline, setting up media streaming with DRM and payload handling.

methods.name: allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Indicates that all app sources have been added, finalizing setup.

methods.name: createPayloader
methods.description: Creates and returns a 'svppay' payloader element if available.
